title: LEGO Produced 10 Billion Minifigures—But Not 10 Billion Survivors
hook: 10 billion is cumulative production, not minifigures confirmed to still exist.
closing: Production totals show cultural scale, but they cannot count what survives.
question: How many survived in your house?

segments.say: LEGO has produced 10 billion minifigures. That is cumulative production, not a count of surviving toys.
Cumulative minifigure production reached 8.3 billion. The total measures output over time, not pieces still in homes.
New minifigure production runs at 400 million yearly. The factory pace outstrips human births.
